analysis: Only CHANGELOG.md changed (documentation; head lines 11-176 are the new v0.10.5 candidate section, with v0.10.4 notes retained below). No executable code is in this batch, so there is no directly introduced security regression. The changelog describes changed behavior whose implementation lives in files outside this batch and was not reviewed: (1) `darkbloom sandbox setup` downloads and runs install.sh from https://api-sandbox.darkbloom.dev as the Mac owner, and the CLI runs the installed add-on's `status --json` (CHANGELOG.md lines 19, 24-25). This is the TB-013/A-019/T-061 surface. The notes mention HTTPS but not signature/hash pinning of the installer, so the next pass should check provider CLI source for installer verification, a consent prompt, and the exit/JSON parsing of add-on output. (2) SSD prefix-cache changes (lines 103-172): concurrent restores, mtime refresh only under contention, header caching in maintenance, 16-file sweep batches, a daily write-budget charge per donation reserved up front, and delta checkpoints. These touch T-041 (at-rest TTL/LRU, HMAC naming, AAD, epoch). Line 107 itself admits that TTL maintenance now relies on in-memory last-restore records and that a restart can drop files, and that disk-budget eviction still orders by mtime. The cached-header optimization (line 142) must keep the authentication checks and ownership decisions unchanged. Whether the 30-minute max TTL and the HMAC lookup tags are preserved cannot be verified from the changelog. (3) Dev-branch lane now signs and notarizes dev builds with the production Developer ID and `secrets: inherit` (lines 30-32, 49), widening who can obtain signed artifacts; this is relevant to T-054/T-034 build-qualification and the release-source gate, and the gate logic needs source review. (4) Dropping response chunks when no connection is bound (lines 72-73) is a positive for cross-session leakage (T-008/A-001). (5) Faster reconnect and 1012 handling (lines 77-79) says registration/attestation is unchanged. (6) The MLX pin bump changes the metallib hash, so cache namespaces rotate. These are unverified contracts, not findings.
